data.spiritual_significance: The name Minnie, meaning 'Little One', can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual significance of humility and childlike faith in Christianity. In Matthew 18:3-4, Jesus says, "...whoever humbles himself like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven." Jesus encourages us to approach God with the faith and trust of a child, and the name Minnie can serve as a reminder of this spiritual virtue.
